title: Add cross-platform tool-binding playground with live contract verifier
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Add new cross-platform quickstart that demonstrates typed tool bindings, live contract verification, telemetry probes, and example integrations for Node/Go/TS. No breaking changes.
description: Motivation: Provide a compact, platform-agnostic quickstart that demonstrates how to bind external tools into RAG-style agents across Node, Go, and a lightweight WASM runner. This playground helps engineers validate tool contracts quickly and iteratively without setting up complex infra. What this PR adds: a self-contained playground under quickstarts/cross-toolbinding with three language adapters (ts, go, wasm), a small contract verifier that runs schema checks against tool responses, telemetry probe hooks that emit compact spans/events for the Redwood Console, and lightweight e2e smoke scripts. Checklist: 1) Add docs and README with quickstart instructions; 2) Provide typed contract schema + verifier binary and npm package wrapper; 3) Add CI smoke job that runs language adapters and verifier in CI; 4) Add example prompt sets and sample index for a toy corpus. Usage summary: checkout, cd quickstarts/cross-toolbinding, run ./scripts/bootstrap.sh to install local adapters, then run npm run dev:ts or go run ./adapters/go/main.go or ./wasm/runner to see tool-calling flow; the verifier will produce a compact contract report in logs. Links: Linear ENG-1287; Support ticket SUP-2211 for telemetry expectations. Notes: the playground is intentionally small (no production infra); telemetry hooks use the console-instrumentation shim with opt-in env var REDWOOD_TELEMETRY=1.
commits: feat: add cross-toolbinding quickstart scaffold; feat: implement TS adapter and README; feat: add Go adapter and dockerless runner; chore: add contract verifier binary + schemas; test: CI smoke job for adapters; docs: add step-by-step quickstart guide and troubleshooting; fix: small linting and CI adjustments

notes_for_changelog: Added a cross-platform tool-binding quickstart demonstrating typed tool contracts and a contract verifier; includes adapters for TypeScript, Go, and a WASM runner. Useful for onboarding and local evaluations.
post_merge_tasks: 1) Publish npm wrapper for verifier (eng-ops); 2) Add shortlink on docs site under Quickstarts; 3) Monitor quickstart telemetry for first-week usage (PM-492)
testing_instructions: Local smoke: ./scripts/bootstrap.sh; npm run dev:ts; go run ./adapters/go/main.go; ./verifier/bin/verifier --schema=verifier/schema/tool.json --input=sample_response.json; CI smoke job replicates these steps in a containerized environment
notes: This PR intentionally avoids the full runtime integration; adapters use a local stub index and echo tool to keep the quickstart lightweight. The verifier is packaged as a small static binary (Linux/amd64) in the repo for convenience.
authors_reply: Thanks for the reviews — addressed schema permissiveness and added explain-mode + retry/backoff in bootstrap. Kept the adapter APIs intentionally minimal for pedagogical clarity. Happy to follow up with an enterprise-ready example that wires into dedicated caches and routing.
